photos.file: CSIRO ScienceImage 953 Asterias amurensis Northern Pacific Seastar.jpg
photos.desc: Asterias amurensis , the Northern Pacific seastar, was accidentally introduced into Australia in the 1980s. It is found in the Derwent Estuary (Hobart), Tasmania and Port Phillip Bay, Victoria.
